title: 第3章 父辱子羞以剑为天立誓言第4章 那年守护之剑竖立镇妖碑前
content_zh:
听见陆晨的话，顾余生的心再一次好似被针扎过一样，一年来，他虽然远离闹市，依旧受尽各种闲言碎语，针扎般的刺痛，让顾余生眼睛布满血丝，他贝齿一咬，下意识的拔出腰间的木剑。
“哈哈哈！”
“一把木剑，也想杀我？”
“也不撒泡尿照照自己！”
看见顾余生拿出一把木剑，陆晨更加肆无忌惮的笑起来，周围的人群，也是微微一愣，看顾余生的表情像看傻子，在这个弱肉强食的世界，没有人会同情弱者。
顾余生也明白这一点。
他上前一步，在无数人嘲笑的目光中，将手中木剑狠狠的扎进自己的大腿上。
噗！
鲜血如梅花绽放。
顾余生缓缓拔出木剑，以手指染血，在脸上划出三道痕迹，当着天下人的面剑指陆晨的眉心，开口道：“陆晨，你我之间本无怨，过去尚有玩伴之谊，但今日你两次辱我父亲在先，我不懂什么大道理，但我懂父辱子羞，今日歃血为誓，三年之后，你我戴冠受礼之日，我必以此剑杀你，讨回今日之辱！”
顾余生的声音不大，但掷地有声！
随着他话落，只见他略显稚嫩的脸上，那三道血痕竟然凝结出一道血珠，在众人都没有反应过来之时，忽然窜入陆晨的身体。
“顾余生，你做了什么！”
陆晨被顾余生染血的木剑吓得后退一步，又被一枚血珠入体，一时之间，竟然有些畏惧害怕，茫然不知所措。
“不好，少爷，歃血之誓，这小子怎么会引动天道誓言！”
陆晨身边，一名管家模样的老者一双眼睛陡然变得锐利，死死的盯着顾余生，一缕杀意闪过，藏在袖子中的手化为掌，就要动手。
“且慢！”
青云门接引使齐明上前一步。
“此地禁止任何争斗！”
他之所以这么说，并非是为了‘公正’，也并非是为了维护顾余生，齐明回头凝望一眼那正在登青云梯看书的莫先生，只见他手上的书正散发出圣洁的光芒，齐明开口喝止道：“陆管家，是这小子的话引动了莫大儒手上的圣院礼书，形成天道誓言，切切不可动手，否则因果誓言会反噬在你家公子身上。”

“什么！”
欲动手的陆管家听见圣院礼书，不由地眼皮狂跳，不甘的放下袖子，死死的盯着顾余生，但他随即一声冷笑。
“天道誓言？那又如何，这万丈青云梯，就会把你这小子挡在门外，三年之后，你只会如一只蚂蚁一样被我家少爷踩死！”
“对，我要踩死你！”
陆晨对顾余生嘶吼咆哮，他确实有被顾余生拼命的架势吓到，色厉内荏，但他一想到自己已经是青云门的弟子，而顾余生还要登青云梯，不由地再次得意起来。
顾余生没有再理会陆晨。
他心有惊雷，他明白，所谓的誓言什么的，绝不是一句空话，而是要行一条路，一条充满荆棘的路。
他把带血的木剑重新挂在腰间。
右腿上的鲜血从裤脚滴落鞋子，一步步的走在人群。
这一刻。
所有人都在为他让路。
嘲笑声也变得沉默。
虽然大部分人内心依旧觉得顾余生是如此的微小如尘埃，可那一句‘父辱子羞’，让很多人内心有些许的共鸣。
来人间一趟。
总是有一些亲情血脉难以割舍。
鸦有反哺之义，羊有跪乳之恩！
许多人凝望着顾余生的那瘦弱的身影，看布满青苔的地面留下一行带血的脚痕，一直延伸到青云梯下。
“他能登青云梯吗？”
人群中，有人问道。
一名面持扇子的中年儒生开口道：“虽然我希望他能入青云，让事情变得有趣一些，但我敢打赌，他走不了三步，因为青云梯，曾经是由万千青云门弟子的鲜血凝练而成。

更有无数妖兽的血死在青萍山，英魂妖魄，形成最为玄妙的青云梯，这是一条炼心之路，如果没有坚强的意志和毅力，每前行一步，都如万钧压身，先辈斩妖明志，死重于山，他的父亲顾白面对妖兽到死都不敢拔剑，他才十二三岁，绝对过不了这一关的。”
顾余生没有理会周围的人。
腿伤锥痛，反而让他前所未有的平静。
他向前迈出，脚踏青云梯，修行之路的第一步！
一股淡淡的威压出现，顾余生仿佛感觉有一座山悬在头顶，朝自己缓缓压来。
content_en:
Hearing Lu Chen's words, Gu Yusheng's heart once again felt as if he had been pricked by a needle. In the past year, although he had stayed away from the bustling city, he still suffered from all kinds of gossip and stinging pains, which made Gu Yusheng's eyes bloodshot. He bit his teeth and subconsciously pulled out the wooden sword at his waist.
"Hahaha!"
"You want to kill me with a wooden sword?"
"Don't even pee and take a look at yourself!"
Seeing Gu Yusheng take out a wooden sword, Lu Chen laughed even more unscrupulously. The crowd around him was also slightly startled, looking at Gu Yusheng's expression as if he was a fool. In this world of the jungle, no one would sympathize with the weak.
Gu Yusheng also understood this.
He took a step forward, and in the eyes of countless people who laughed at him, he plunged the wooden sword in his hand into his thigh.
puff!
Blood blooms like plum blossoms.
Gu Yusheng slowly pulled out the wooden sword, stained his fingers with blood, made three marks on his face, pointed the sword at Lu Chen's eyebrows in front of everyone in the world, and said: "Lu Chen, there is no grudge between you and me. We were still friends in the past, but today you insulted my father twice, first. I don't understand the truth, but I understand that it is shameful for a father to humiliate his son, and I swear by my blood today. Three years later, on the day when you and I wear the crown and receive the ceremony, I will kill you with this sword to avenge today's humiliation!"
Gu Yusheng's voice was not loud, but it was loud!
As he finished speaking, the three blood marks on his slightly immature face actually condensed into a blood bead, and before anyone could react, it suddenly rushed into Lu Chen's body.
"Gu Yusheng, what have you done!"
Lu Chen was frightened by Gu Yusheng's blood-stained wooden sword and took a step back. Another blood bead entered his body. For a moment, he felt a little frightened and at a loss.
"No, young master, I swear by blood, how could this kid trigger the oath of heaven!"
Next to Lu Chen, an old man who looked like a housekeeper suddenly had sharp eyes. He stared at Gu Yusheng. A flash of murderous intent flashed through him. The hand hidden in his sleeve turned into a palm and he was about to take action.
"Wait!"
Qingyunmen led Qi Ming to take a step forward.
"No fighting is allowed here!"
The reason why he said this was not for the sake of 'justice', nor to protect Gu Yusheng. Qi Ming turned back and glanced at Mr. Mo who was reading a book on the Qingyun Staircase. He saw that the book in his hand was emitting a holy light. Qi Ming shouted: "Steward Lu, it was this boy's words that triggered the Holy Academy ritual book in Mo Daru's hand to form an oath of heaven. Don't do anything, otherwise the oath of karma will backfire on your young master."
"What!"
Butler Lu, who was about to take action, couldn't help but his eyelids twitched when he heard the Holy Court's etiquette. He reluctantly put down his sleeves and stared at Gu Yusheng, but he then sneered.
"Heaven's oath? So what, this ten thousand-foot Qingyun Ladder will keep you kid out of the door. In three years, you will only be trampled to death by my young master like an ant!"
"Yes, I will trample you to death!"
Lu Chen roared at Gu Yusheng. He was indeed frightened by Gu Yusheng's desperate posture, and his expression was fierce but he couldn't help but feel proud again when he thought that he was already a disciple of the Qingyun Sect, and Gu Yusheng had to climb the Qingyun Ladder.
Gu Yusheng ignored Lu Chen.
He was shocked, and he understood that the so-called vows were by no means empty words, but a road to walk, a road full of thorns.
He hung the bloody wooden sword on his waist again.
The blood on his right leg dripped from his trousers and onto his shoes as he walked in the crowd step by step.
This moment.
Everyone was making way for him.
The jeers fell silent.
Although most people still feel that Gu Yusheng is as insignificant as dust in their hearts, but the sentence "the father humiliates the son" resonates a little in many people's hearts.
Come to the human world.
There are always some family ties that are difficult to let go of.
The crow has the meaning of feeding back, and the sheep has the kindness of kneeling to breastfeed!
Many people stared at Gu Yusheng's thin figure and saw a line of bloody feet left on the moss-covered ground.The traces extend all the way to the bottom of the Qingyun Ladder.
"Can he climb the Qingyun Ladder?"
Someone in the crowd asked.
A middle-aged Confucian scholar holding a fan said: "Although I hope he can enter Qingyun to make things more interesting, I bet that he can't walk three steps, because the Qingyun Staircase was once condensed from the blood of thousands of Qingyun Sect disciples.
The blood of countless demonic beasts died in Qingping Mountain, and their heroic souls formed the most mysterious Qingyun Ladder. This is a path of refining the heart. Without strong will and perseverance, every step forward is like a huge pressure. The ancestors slayed the demons clearly, and death was heavier than the mountain. His father Gu Bai did not dare to draw his sword when facing the demonic beasts until he died. He was only twelve or thirteen years old, and he would never pass this level. "
Gu Yusheng ignored the people around him.
The pain in his leg made him feel calmer than ever before.
He steps forward, stepping on the Qingyun Ladder, the first step on the road to spiritual practice!
A faint coercion appeared, and Gu Yusheng seemed to feel like there was a mountain hanging above his head, slowly pressing towards him.
